examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 今天藝術系的學生要在學校的禮堂，演出跟十二生肖有關的故事。 那名演員很厲害，在那部電影裡一個人演出三個角色。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān yìshù xì de xuéshēng yào zài xuéxiào de lǐtáng, yǎnchū gēn shí'èr shēngxiào yǒuguān de gùshì. Nà míng yǎnyuán hěn lìhài, zài nà bù diànyǐng lǐ yīgè rén yǎnchū sān gè juésè.
examples.english: Today the art department students are going to perform a story related to the twelve zodiac signs in the school auditorium. That actor is very impressive; in that movie, he performed three roles by himself.

examples.chinese: 以電腦系統取代傳統收停車費的方式，能幫老闆節省工作人員的費用。
examples.pinyin: Yǐ diànnǎo xìtǒng qǔdài chuántǒng shōu tíngchē fèi de fāngshì, néng bāng lǎobǎn jiéshěng gōngzuò rényuán de fèiyòng.
examples.english: Replacing the traditional method of collecting parking fees with a computer system can help the boss save on staff costs.

examples.chinese: 那家店的門是自動的，只要站到門前就會自動打開。這棟大樓有安全系統的設備，小偷進去就會自動發出警告的聲音通知警察。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn de mén shì zìdòng de, zhǐyào zhàn dào mén qián jiù huì zìdòng dǎkāi. Zhè dòng dàlóu yǒu ānquán xìtǒng de shèbèi, xiǎotōu jìnqù jiù huì zìdòng fāchū jǐnggào de shēngyīn tōngzhī jǐngchá.
examples.english: The door of that shop is automatic; as soon as you stand in front of the door, it will open automatically. This building has safety system equipment; if a thief enters, it will automatically emit a warning sound to notify the police.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 歷史系的李教授最近經常接受記者的訪問，因此變得很有名。那名記者為了訪問總統外交、貿易等方面的問題，閱讀了許多相關的資料。
examples.pinyin: Lìshǐ xì de Lǐ jiàoshòu zuìjìn jīngcháng jiēshòu jìzhě de fǎngwèn, yīncǐ biàn de hěn yǒumíng. Nà míng jìzhě wèile fǎngwèn zǒngtǒng wàijiāo, màoyì děng fāngmiàn de wèntí, yuèdú le xǔduō xiāngguān de zīliào.
examples.english: Professor Li from the History Department has recently often been interviewed by reporters, and therefore has become very famous. That reporter, in order to interview the president about questions on diplomacy, trade, and other aspects, read a lot of related materials.

items.wordHook: A guiding stroke 丿(slash) organizes tangled strands of fine 糸(silk) into an orderly 系(system).

examples.chinese: 我剛買的皮包被小偷偷了，讓我又生氣又難過。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng mǎi de píbāo bèi xiǎotōu tōu le, ràng wǒ yòu shēngqì yòu nánguò.
examples.english: The purse I just bought was stolen by a thief, which made me both angry and sad.

examples.chinese: 當我難過的時候，最需要的是家人與好友的安慰。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wǒ nánguò de shíhòu, zuì xūyào de shì jiārén yǔ hǎoyǒu de ānwèi.
examples.english: When I am sad, what I need most is the comfort of family and good friends.

examples.chinese: 夫妻之間要是缺少了愛情，日子就比較難過下去。
examples.pinyin: Fūqī zhījiān yàoshi quēshǎole àiqíng, rìzi jiù bǐjiào nánguò xiàqù.
examples.english: If husband and wife lack love between them, life becomes harder to endure.

examples.chinese: 他不小心摔壞了新買的手機，因此難過得要命。
examples.pinyin: Tā bù xiǎoxīn shuāihuài le xīn mǎi de shǒujī, yīncǐ nánguò de yàomìng.
examples.english: He accidentally dropped and broke his newly bought cell phone, so he was extremely upset.

examples.chinese: 沒有專業能力的人，想找到好職業是很困難的。
examples.pinyin: Méiyǒu zhuānyè nénglì de rén, xiǎng zhǎodào hǎo zhíyè shì hěn kùnnán de.
examples.english: For people without professional skills, finding a good job is very difficult.

examples.chinese: 我相信有專業能力就比較容易找到好工作。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiāngxìn yǒu zhuānyè nénglì jiù bǐjiào róngyì zhǎodào hǎo gōngzuò.
examples.english: I believe that if you have professional ability, it is relatively easy to find a good job.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 王太太把全家照顧得非常好，王先生很感謝她對家庭的貢獻。每個大學生畢業後，都應該為社會貢獻自己的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Wáng tàitai bǎ quánjiā zhàogù de fēicháng hǎo, Wáng xiānsheng hěn gǎnxiè tā duì jiātíng de gòngxiàn. Měi gè dàxuéshēng bìyè hòu, dōu yīnggāi wèi shèhuì gòngxiàn zìjǐ de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: Mrs. Wang takes very good care of the whole family; Mr. Wang is very grateful for her contribution to the family. After every university student graduates, they should contribute their professional abilities to society.

examples.chinese: 爺爺照醫生的專業建議調整飲食，現在健康情況改善了不少。
examples.pinyin: Yéye zhào yīshēng de zhuānyè jiànyì tiáozhěng yǐnshí, xiànzài jiànkāng qíngkuàng gǎishànle bùshǎo.
examples.english: Grandpa adjusted his diet according to the doctor's professional advice, and now his health condition has improved quite a bit.

examples.chinese: 大學教育的目的，不僅要提高學生的知識水準，還要進一步培養學生的專業能力。
examples.pinyin: Dàxué jiàoyù de mùdì, bùjǐn yào tígāo xuéshēng de zhīshì shuǐzhǔn, hái yào jìnyībù péiyǎng xuéshēng de zhuānyè nénglì.
examples.english: The purpose of university education is not only to raise students' level of knowledge but also to further cultivate students' professional abilities.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
examples.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

examples.chinese: 學習外國語言時最好能找位專業的老師，好改正自己的錯誤。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí wàiguó yǔyán shí zuìhǎo néng zhǎo wèi zhuānyè de lǎoshī, hǎo gǎizhèng zìjǐ de cuòwù.
examples.english: When learning a foreign language, it's best to find a professional teacher so as to correct your own mistakes.

examples.chinese: 當外科醫生不容易，不僅要有手術的專業能力，體力也得夠好。
examples.pinyin: Dāng wàikē yīshēng bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào yǒu shǒushù de zhuānyè nénglì, tǐlì yě děi gòu hǎo.
examples.english: Being a surgery doctor is not easy; you not only need professional surgical skills, but your physical strength also has to be good enough.

examples.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
examples.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
examples.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

examples.chinese: 她的專業是人工智慧，這個領域的問題可以請教她。
examples.pinyin: Tā de zhuānyè shì réngōng zhìhuì, zhège lǐngyù de wèntí kěyǐ qǐngjiào tā.
examples.english: Her specialty is artificial intelligence; you can ask her about problems in this field.

examples.chinese: 現在已經沒有所謂的鐵飯碗了，有專業技術才有保障。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài yǐjīng méiyǒu suǒwèi de tiěfànwǎn le, yǒu zhuānyè jìshù cái yǒu bǎozhàng.
examples.english: Nowadays there is no so-called iron rice bowl anymore; only with professional skills can you have security.

examples.chinese: 這位記者專門報導社會新聞，他報新聞的方式相當專業。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi jìzhě zhuānmén bàodǎo shèhuì xīnwén, tā bào xīnwén de fāngshì xiāngdāng zhuānyè.
examples.english: This reporter specializes in reporting social news; the way he reports news is quite professional.

examples.chinese: 職業棒球隊在比賽時，會請專業啦啦隊來製造熱鬧氣氛。
examples.pinyin: Zhíyè bàngqiú duì zài bǐsài shí, huì qǐng zhuānyè lālādùi lái zhìzào rènào qìfēn.
examples.english: When professional baseball teams are playing, they invite professional cheerleading squads to create a lively atmosphere.

examples.chinese: 大寶明年有去英國留學的打算，所以找了家庭教師幫他補習， 希望提高英文程度。
examples.pinyin: Dàbǎo míngnián yǒu qù Yīngguó liúxué de dǎsuàn, suǒyǐ zhǎo le jiātíng jiàoshī bāng tā bǔxí, xīwàng tígāo Yīngwén chéngdù.
examples.english: Dabao plans to study abroad in the UK next year, so he found a private tutor to help him with cram tutoring, hoping to improve his English level.

examples.chinese: 許多青少年為了考上好學校，不得不犧牲假日去補習。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō qīngshàonián wèile kǎo shàng hǎo xuéxiào, bùdébù xīshēng jiàrì qù bǔxí.
examples.english: Many teenagers, in order to get into a good school, have no choice but to sacrifice their holidays to go to cram school.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 他最近對你說話的態度變得冷淡，你們之間是不是有什麼誤會？
examples.pinyin: Tā zuìjìn duì nǐ shuōhuà de tàidù biàn de lěngdàn, nǐmen zhījiān shì bùshì yǒu shénme wùhuì?
examples.english: His attitude when speaking to you has recently become cold; is there some misunderstanding between you two?

examples.chinese: 由於每個人看事情的角度不同，所以得溝通才能避免誤會。那個模特兒個子高、長得美，從什麼角度拍都漂亮。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú měi gè rén kàn shìqíng de jiǎodù bùtóng, suǒyǐ děi gōutōng cái néng bìmiǎn wùhuì. Nàge mótè'ér gèzi gāo, zhǎng de měi, cóng shénme jiǎodù pāi dōu piàoliang.
examples.english: Because each person's point of view on things is different, communication is necessary to avoid misunderstandings. That model is tall and beautiful; from whatever angle you photograph her, she looks pretty.

examples.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
examples.pinyin: Qián jǐ tiān tāmen yīnwèi yìdiǎnr xiǎo wùhuì chǎo le yí jià, háohǎo xiànzài héhǎo le.
examples.english: A few days ago they had a quarrel because of a small misunderstanding—good thing they've become reconciled now.

examples.chinese: 別人對你有誤會的時候用不著生氣，解釋清楚就好。
examples.pinyin: Biérén duì nǐ yǒu wùhuì de shíhou yòngbuzháo shēngqì, jiěshì qīngchu jiù hǎo.
examples.english: When others misunderstand you, there's no need to get angry; just explain clearly.

examples.chinese: 知道自己誤會別人以後，最好早一點兒跟對方道歉。
examples.pinyin: Zhīdào zìjǐ wùhuì biérén yǐhòu, zuì hǎo zǎo yīdiǎnr gēn duìfāng dàoqiàn.
examples.english: After you realize you have misunderstood someone, it's best to apologize to the other person a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 如果想得到獎學金，必須達成每科成績八十五分以上的要求。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ xiǎng dédào jiǎngxuéjīn, bìxū dáchéng měi kē chéngjì bāshíwǔ fēn yǐshàng de yāoqiú.
examples.english: If you want to get the scholarship, you must fulfill the requirement of a score of eighty-five or above in every subject.

examples.chinese: 擔任這家公司的主管真不容易，不僅要管理整個部門的員工，還要達成老闆的工作要求。
examples.pinyin: Dānrèn zhè jiā gōngsī de zhǔguǎn zhēn bù róngyì, bùjǐn yào guǎnlǐ zhěnggè bùmén de yuángōng, hái yào dáchéng lǎobǎn de gōngzuò yāoqiú.
examples.english: Serving as a supervisor at this company is really not easy; not only do you have to manage the employees of the entire department, you also have to fulfill the boss's work requirements.

examples.chinese: 我想了許多辦法去達成公司的目標，卻還是得不到主管的支持。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng le xǔduō bànfǎ qù dáchéng gōngsī de mùbiāo, què háishì dé bú dào zhǔguǎn de zhīchí.
examples.english: I thought of many ways to achieve the company's goal, but still couldn't get the supervisor's support.

examples.chinese: 公司如果關心客戶並達成他們的需求，對業務或多或少有好處。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī rúguǒ guānxīn kèhù bìng dáchéng tāmen de xūqiú, duì yèwù huòduōhuòshǎo yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: If a company cares about its customers and meets their needs, it is more or less beneficial to the business.

examples.chinese: 我覺得減少工作，增加有意義的休閒活動，這樣的生活比較充實。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde jiǎnshǎo gōngzuò, zēngjiā yǒu yìyì de xiūxián huódòng, zhèyàng de shēnghuó bǐjiào chōngshí.
examples.english: I think reducing work and increasing meaningful leisure activities—this kind of life is more fulfilling.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 要維持社區良好的生活品質，就要從不亂丟垃圾、減少家庭噪音做起。
examples.pinyin: Yào wéichí shèqū liánghǎo de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, jiù yào cóng bù luàn diū lèsè, jiǎnshǎo jiātíng zàoyīn zuò qǐ.
examples.english: To maintain a good quality of life in the community, we must start by not littering and reducing household noise.

examples.chinese: 如果能好好利用食物材料，就能有效地減少廚餘。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ néng hǎohǎo lìyòng shíwù cáiliào, jiù néng yǒuxiào de jiǎnshǎo chúyú.
examples.english: If food materials can be used well, kitchen waste can be effectively reduced.

examples.chinese: 為了更有效地利用地球資源，我寧願減少不必要的生活享受。
examples.pinyin: Wèile gèng yǒuxiào de lìyòng dìqiú zīyuán, wǒ nìngyuàn jiǎnshǎo bù bìyào de shēnghuó xiǎngshòu.
examples.english: In order to use Earth's resources more effectively, I would rather reduce unnecessary life pleasures.

items.wordHook: Scaling back to 減(decrease) waste and keep amounts 少(few): 減少 means reduce, decrease.

examples.chinese: 跟張先生聊天時，總是我問一句，他答一句，真沒意思。
examples.pinyin: Gēn Zhāng xiānsheng liáotiān shí, zǒngshì wǒ wèn yī jù, tā dá yī jù, zhēn méi yìsi.
examples.english: When chatting with Mr. Zhang, it's always I ask one sentence and he answers one sentence; it's really boring.

examples.chinese: 他說：「你唱得很好。」這個中文句子對嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tā shuō: “Nǐ chàng de hěn hǎo.” Zhège Zhōngwén jùzi duì ma?
examples.english: He said, “You sing very well.” Is this Chinese sentence correct?

examples.chinese: 這些中文句子不難，我都懂。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē Zhōngwén jùzi bù nán, wǒ dōu dǒng.
examples.english: These Chinese sentences are not difficult; I understand them all.

examples.chinese: 這個句子的意思是什麼？妳知道嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhège jùzi de yìsi shì shénme? Nǐ zhīdào ma?
examples.english: What is the meaning of this sentence? Do you know?

examples.chinese: 友美，這幾個句子的意思我不太懂，妳可以教我嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒuměi, zhè jǐ ge jùzi de yìsi wǒ bú tài dǒng, nǐ kěyǐ jiāo wǒ ma?
examples.english: Youmei, I don’t quite understand these sentences. Could you teach me?

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

items.wordHook: a 勹(wrap) holds a 口(mouth) snugly → one short 句(sentence).

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 儘管爺爺去世很久了，但每次看到照片，就會回想起他開心陪我玩的樣子。
examples.pinyin: Jǐnguǎn yéye qùshì hěn jiǔ le, dàn měi cì kàn dào zhàopiàn, jiù huì huíxiǎng qǐ tā kāixīn péi wǒ wán de yàngzi.
examples.english: Even though Grandpa passed away a long time ago, every time I see a photo, I recall how he happily played with me.

items.wordHook: Stepping 回(measure word for time) into or toward 想(think): 回想 means recall.

examples.chinese: 那位畫家的作品十分生動，畫裡的人物好像真的能從畫裡走出來一樣。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi huàjiā de zuòpǐn shífēn shēngdòng, huà lǐ de rénwù hǎoxiàng zhēn de néng cóng huà lǐ zǒu chūlái yīyàng.
examples.english: That painter's works are extremely vivid; the figures in the paintings seem as if they could really walk out of the paintings.

examples.chinese: 這本書有豐富的內容及生動的鉛筆畫，是吸引讀者購買的主要原因。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn shū yǒu fēngfù de nèiróng jí shēngdòng de qiānbǐhuà, shì xīyǐn dúzhě gòumǎi de zhǔyào yuányīn.
examples.english: This book has rich content and lively pencil drawings, which are the main reasons that attract readers to buy it.

examples.chinese: 誰都無法告訴你生命的意義是什麼，只能自己去尋找答案。
examples.pinyin: Shéi dōu wúfǎ gàosù nǐ shēngmìng de yìyì shì shénme, zhǐ néng zìjǐ qù xúnzhǎo dá'àn.
examples.english: No one is able to tell you what the meaning of life is; you can only search for the answer yourself.

examples.chinese: 有一些研究科學的人，對不科學、無法合理解釋的現象都不太相信。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yìxiē yánjiū kēxué de rén, duì bù kēxué, wúfǎ hélǐ jiěshì de xiànxiàng dōu bú tài xiāngxìn.
examples.english: Some people who study science do not really believe in unscientific phenomena that cannot be reasonably explained.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 學習是別人無法代你去做的，得親自來。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxí shì biérén wúfǎ dài nǐ qù zuò de, děi qīnzì lái.
examples.english: Learning is something others cannot do on your behalf—you have to do it yourself.

examples.chinese: 我們無法決定生命的長度，卻能夠決定生活的品質。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ juédìng shēngmìng de chángdù, què nénggòu juédìng shēnghuó de pǐnzhì.
examples.english: We cannot decide the length of life, but we can decide the quality of life.

examples.chinese: 假如缺乏陽光、空氣和水這三項條件，植物就無法生長。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎrú quēfá yángguāng, kōngqì hé shuǐ zhè sān xiàng tiáojiàn, zhíwù jiù wúfǎ shēngzhǎng.
examples.english: If plants lack the three conditions of sunlight, air, and water, they cannot grow.

examples.chinese: 一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè guójiā guāng shì yīkào miǎnfèi qiānzhèng, shì wúfǎ xīyǐn guówài yóukè lái lǚxíng de.
examples.english: A country solely relying on free visas is unable to attract foreign tourists to travel.

examples.chinese: 七歲以下的孩子對手部動作還無法完全地掌握，因此不應要求他們正確地握筆。
examples.pinyin: Qī suì yǐxià de háizi duì shǒubù dòngzuò hái wúfǎ wánquán de zhǎngwò, yīncǐ bù yīng yāoqiú tāmen zhèngquè de wò bǐ.
examples.english: Children under seven years old still cannot fully master hand movements, so they should not be required to hold a pen correctly.

examples.chinese: 碰到困難無法繼續前進時，暫時後退等待機會也是一種作法。
examples.pinyin: Pèngdào kùnnán wúfǎ jìxù qiánjìn shí, zànshí hòutuì děngdài jīhuì yě shì yī zhǒng zuòfǎ.
examples.english: When you encounter difficulties and cannot continue to advance, temporarily retreating and waiting for an opportunity is also a kind of approach.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦無法上網，檢查之後才發現網路線沒有接著電腦。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo wúfǎ shàngwǎng, jiǎnchá zhīhòu cái fāxiàn wǎnglùxiàn méiyǒu jiēzhe diànnǎo.
examples.english: My computer can't get online; only after checking did I discover that the network cable was not connected to the computer.

examples.chinese: 我們無法控制別人的行為，卻能夠改變自己的想法。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen wúfǎ kòngzhì biérén de xíngwéi, què nénggòu gǎibiàn zìjǐ de xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: We cannot control other people's behavior, but we can change our own thoughts.

examples.chinese: 如果遇到無法處理的心理問題，最好請專業人員來輔導。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ yùdào wúfǎ chǔlǐ de xīnlǐ wèntí, zuìhǎo qǐng zhuānyè rényuán lái fǔdǎo.
examples.english: If you encounter psychological problems you cannot handle, it's best to ask professionals to give guidance.

examples.chinese: 我從沒去過澳洲，無法想像那裡的景色有多美。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ cóng méi qùguò Àozhōu, wúfǎ xiǎngxiàng nàlǐ de jǐngsè yǒu duō měi.
examples.english: I have never been to Australia and cannot imagine how beautiful the scenery there is.

examples.chinese: 有時一個人的前途無法先規劃好，必須自己創造。
examples.pinyin: Yǒushí yī gè rén de qiántú wúfǎ xiān guīhuà hǎo, bìxū zìjǐ chuàngzào.
examples.english: Sometimes a person's prospects cannot be planned out in advance; one must create them oneself.

examples.chinese: 鑽石因為無法大量出產，所以才變得珍貴。
examples.pinyin: Zuànshí yīnwèi wúfǎ dàliàng chūchǎn, suǒyǐ cái biàn de zhēnguì.
examples.english: Because diamonds cannot be produced in large quantities, they have become precious.

examples.chinese: 天天說自己外行、不願嘗試的人，就無法更深入地瞭解世界。
examples.pinyin: Tiāntiān shuō zìjǐ wàiháng, bù yuàn chángshì de rén, jiù wúfǎ gèng shēnrù de liǎojiě shìjiè.
examples.english: People who say they are laymen every day and are unwilling to try cannot understand the world more deeply.

examples.chinese: 各行各業都有屬於自己的專業，無法比較誰高誰低。
examples.pinyin: Gè háng gè yè dōu yǒu shǔyú zìjǐ de zhuānyè, wúfǎ bǐjiào shéi gāo shéi dī.
examples.english: Every profession has its own specialty; it is impossible to compare who is higher and who is lower.

examples.chinese: 動不動就發脾氣的人，往往無法接受別人的寶貴建議。
examples.pinyin: Dòngbùdòng jiù fā píqì de rén, wǎngwǎng wúfǎ jiēshòu biérén de bǎoguì jiànyì.
examples.english: People who easily lose their temper often cannot accept others' valuable advice.

examples.chinese: 如果不與別人競爭，你就無法進步。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ bù yǔ biérén jìngzhēng, nǐ jiù wúfǎ jìnbù.
examples.english: If you don't compete with others, you won't be able to make progress.

examples.chinese: 我的電腦系統無法升級，所以很多功能都不能使用。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de diànnǎo xìtǒng wúfǎ shēngjí, suǒyǐ hěn duō gōngnéng dōu bùnéng shǐyòng.
examples.english: My computer system cannot be upgraded, so many functions cannot be used.

examples.chinese: 申請簽證的表格請填完整資料，以免無法順利申請。
examples.pinyin: Shēnqǐng qiānzhèng de biǎogé qǐng tián wánzhěng zīliào, yǐmiǎn wúfǎ shùnlì shēnqǐng.
examples.english: Please fill out the visa application form with complete information, so as to avoid being unable to apply successfully.

examples.chinese: 在臺灣，有人說夏天開冷氣不如開除溼機，不過有專家表示，它們的功能無法互相取代。
examples.pinyin: Zài Táiwān, yǒu rén shuō xiàtiān kāi lěngqì bùrú kāi chúshījī, bùguò yǒu zhuānjiā biǎoshì, tāmen de gōngnéng wúfǎ hùxiāng qǔdài.
examples.english: In Taiwan, some people say that in summer, turning on the air conditioner is not as good as turning on a dehumidifier, but some experts say that their functions cannot replace each other.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

examples.chinese: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài yǐ dǎ dào zuìhòu yì jú, kěshì réng wúfǎ kànchū shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: This baseball game has already reached the final inning, but it is still impossible to tell who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 情侶之間如果無法相信彼此，很容易就分手了。
examples.pinyin: Qínglǚ zhījiān rúguǒ wúfǎ xiāngxìn bǐcǐ, hěn róngyì jiù fēnshǒu le.
examples.english: If couples cannot trust each other, they easily break up.

examples.chinese: 爸爸挑選西裝時，最重視的是品質，其次才是式樣。
examples.pinyin: Bàba tiāoxuǎn xīzhuāng shí, zuì zhòngshì de shì pǐnzhì, qícì cái shì shìyàng.
examples.english: When Dad chooses a suit, what he values most is quality; style comes second.

examples.chinese: 我跟朋友手機的式樣很接近，難怪我們常常拿錯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn péngyǒu shǒujī de shìyàng hěn jiējìn, nánguài wǒmen chángcháng ná cuò.
examples.english: My friend's and my cell phones are very similar in style; no wonder we often take the wrong one.

examples.chinese: 室友A:嘿，吃完飯後不能把碗筷擺在桌子讓別人洗喔。室友B:不好意思，我這就去洗。室友A:嘿，你還真聽話(obedient)啊。
examples.pinyin: Shìyǒu A: Hēi, chī wán fàn hòu bùnéng bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi zài zhuōzi ràng biérén xǐ o. Shìyǒu B: Bù hǎoyìsi, wǒ zhè jiù qù xǐ. Shìyǒu A: Hēi, nǐ hái zhēn tīnghuà a.
examples.english: Roommate A: Hey, after eating you can't leave your bowls and chopsticks on the table for others to wash. Roommate B: Sorry, I'll go wash them right now. Roommate A: Hey, you really are obedient!

examples.chinese: 這是我剛買回來的魚，吃起來又鮮又甜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì wǒ gāng mǎi huílái de yú, chī qǐlái yòu xiān yòu tián.
examples.english: This is the fish I just bought; it tastes both fresh and sweet.

examples.chinese: 鮮奶是做冰淇淋、甜點不可少的東西。
examples.pinyin: Xiānnǎi shì zuò bīngqílín, tiándiǎn bùkě shǎo de dōngxi.
examples.english: Fresh milk is an indispensable thing for making ice cream and desserts.

examples.chinese: 這道菜是用新鮮蔬果做的，不僅味道甘甜，對健康也有好處。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài shì yòng xīnxiān shūguǒ zuò de, bùjǐn wèidào gāntián, duì jiànkāng yě yǒu hǎochù.
examples.english: This dish is made with fresh vegetables and fruits; not only does it taste sweet, but it is also good for your health.

examples.chinese: 這個地區不僅沒有地震、颱風，而且天氣好、空氣新鮮，生活環境安全又舒適。
examples.pinyin: Zhège dìqū bùjǐn méiyǒu dìzhèn, táifēng, érqiě tiānqì hǎo, kōngqì xīnxiān, shēnghuó huánjìng ānquán yòu shūshì.
examples.english: This area not only has no earthquakes or typhoons, but also has good weather and fresh air; the living environment is safe and comfortable.

examples.chinese: 這個用活魚做的菜又新鮮又好吃。
examples.pinyin: Zhège yòng huóyú zuò de cài yòu xīnxiān yòu hǎochī.
examples.english: This dish made with live fish is both fresh and delicious.

examples.chinese: 這家超市的水果不但很新鮮，也很便宜。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā chāoshì de shuǐguǒ búdàn hěn xīnxiān, yě hěn piányi.
examples.english: The fruit at this supermarket is not only very fresh but also very cheap.

examples.chinese: 每次到了特別的節日，張先生就會送鮮花給太太，真是浪漫。
examples.pinyin: Měi cì dào le tèbié de jiérì, Zhāng xiānsheng jiù huì sòng xiānhuā gěi tàitai, zhēn shì làngmàn.
examples.english: Every time a special holiday comes, Mr. Zhang sends fresh flowers to his wife; it's truly romantic.

examples.chinese: 媽媽買了鮮花來插花，她覺得插花是一門藝術，讓人欣賞到花的美。
examples.pinyin: Māma mǎi le xiānhuā lái chāhuā, tā juéde chāhuā shì yī mén yìshù, ràng rén xīnshǎng dào huā de měi.
examples.english: Mom bought fresh flowers to do flower arranging; she feels that flower arranging is an art that lets people appreciate the beauty of flowers.

examples.chinese: 那個農村裡有個小農場，他們生產的鮮奶冰淇淋非常好吃。
examples.pinyin: Nàge nóngcūn lǐ yǒu ge xiǎo nóngchǎng, tāmen shēngchǎn de xiānnǎi bīngqílín fēicháng hǎochī.
examples.english: In that village there is a small farm; the fresh milk ice cream they produce is very delicious.

examples.chinese: 那個甜點的顏色像鮮血一樣，讓我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Nàge tiándiǎn de yánsè xiàng xiānxuè yīyàng, ràng wǒ xiàle yī tiào.
examples.english: The color of that dessert was like fresh blood, which gave me a fright.

examples.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
examples.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

examples.chinese: 從我辦公室隔著玻璃往外看，可以看見開滿鮮花的花園。
examples.pinyin: Cóng wǒ bàngōngshì gézhe bōlí wǎng wài kàn, kěyǐ kànjiàn kāi mǎn xiānhuā de huāyuán.
examples.english: Looking out through the glass from my office, I can see a garden full of blooming flowers.

examples.chinese: 這本小說的內容重複性太高，一點新鮮感都沒有。
examples.pinyin: Zhè běn xiǎoshuō de nèiróng chóngfùxìng tài gāo, yìdiǎn xīnxiāngǎn dōu méiyǒu.
examples.english: The content of this novel is too repetitive; it has no freshness at all.

examples.chinese: 保存食物的方式會影響食物的新鮮程度。
examples.pinyin: Bǎocún shíwù de fāngshì huì yǐngxiǎng shíwù de xīnxiān chéngdù.
examples.english: The way of preserving food will affect the freshness of the food.

examples.chinese: 我習慣在家裡放一盆花，讓室內有鮮花的香味。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xíguàn zài jiālǐ fàng yī pén huā, ràng shìnèi yǒu xiānhuā de xiāngwèi.
examples.english: I am used to placing a pot of flowers at home, so that the room has the fragrance of fresh flowers.

examples.chinese: 身體不舒服時，就應該吃對身體負擔較小、容易消化的食物。
examples.pinyin: Shēntǐ bù shūfu shí, jiù yīnggāi chī duì shēntǐ fùdān jiào xiǎo, róngyì xiāohuà de shíwù.
examples.english: When you feel unwell, you should eat food that is less of a burden on the body and easy to digest.

examples.chinese: 肚子痛有時不一定是消化器官的問題，得去醫院檢查。
examples.pinyin: Dùzi tòng yǒushí bù yídìng shì xiāohuà qìguān de wèntí, děi qù yīyuàn jiǎnchá.
examples.english: A stomachache is sometimes not necessarily a problem with the digestive organs; you need to go to the hospital for an examination.

examples.chinese: 電腦和手機要是不常擦的話，比馬桶還骯髒。
examples.pinyin: Diànnǎo hé shǒujī yàoshi bù cháng cā de huà, bǐ mǎtǒng hái āngzāng.
examples.english: If computers and cell phones aren't wiped often, they are dirtier than toilet bowls.

examples.chinese: 不論是工業或家庭廢水，對人們的健康都有不好的影響。
examples.pinyin: Bùlùn shì gōngyè huò jiātíng fèishuǐ, duì rénmen de jiànkāng dōu yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng.
examples.english: Whether industrial or household waste water, it all has a bad impact on people's health.

examples.chinese: 有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā wèi le xīyǐn gèng duō de guānguāngkè lái lǚyóu, jiù bǎ yìxiē chūjìng, rùjìng de shǒuxù gǎi jiǎndān le.
examples.english: Some countries, in order to attract more tourists to travel, have simplified some exit and entry procedures.

examples.chinese: 有些運動中心規定個人得帶自己的毛巾，否則不可以進去。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē yùndòng zhōngxīn guīdìng gèrén děi dài zìjǐ de máojīn, fǒuzé bù kěyǐ jìnqù.
examples.english: Some sports centers require individuals to bring their own towels; otherwise, they cannot enter.

examples.chinese: 東部山區一連下了好幾天的大雨，有些房子倒了，公路也塌了，造成不少意外。
examples.pinyin: Dōngbù shānqū yíliàn xià le hǎo jǐ tiān de dàyǔ, yǒuxiē fángzi dǎo le, gōnglù yě tā le, zàochéng bùshǎo yìwài.
examples.english: In the eastern mountain area, it rained heavily for several days in a row; some houses collapsed, and the highway also collapsed, causing many accidents.

examples.chinese: 陳先生在醫院裡著急地等待小孩出生。有些人等待了一輩子，都等不到高升的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chén xiānsheng zài yīyuàn lǐ zháojí de děngdài xiǎohái chūshēng. Yǒuxiē rén děngdài le yíbèizi, dōu děng bú dào gāoshēng de jīhuì.
examples.english: Mr. Chen is anxiously waiting in the hospital for his child to be born. Some people wait their whole life and never get a chance for promotion.

examples.chinese: 在夜市買東西的時候，有些人會跟老闆殺價。
examples.pinyin: Zài yèshì mǎi dōngxi de shíhou, yǒuxiē rén huì gēn lǎobǎn shājià.
examples.english: When shopping at the night market, some people will bargain with the vendor.

examples.chinese: 逃避或許是解決問題的一種方式，但有些問題是你逃不了，不得不解決的。
examples.pinyin: Táobì huòxǔ shì jiějué wèntí de yī zhǒng fāngshì, dàn yǒuxiē wèntí shì nǐ táo bù liǎo, bùdébù jiějué de.
examples.english: Escaping may be one way to solve a problem, but some problems are ones you cannot escape and have no choice but to solve.

examples.chinese: 有些事明明不對，卻因沒人敢說，久了以後就被社會接受了。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì míngmíng bù duì, què yīn méi rén gǎn shuō, jiǔ le yǐhòu jiù bèi shèhuì jiēshòu le.
examples.english: Some things are obviously wrong, yet because no one dares to speak up, after a long time they are accepted by society.

examples.chinese: 有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā jīchǎng duì xiédài wùpǐn de guīdìng hěn yán, chūguó qián zuìhǎo liǎojiě qīngchu.
examples.english: Some countries' airports have very strict regulations on carried items; before going abroad, it's best to understand them clearly.

examples.chinese: 經過我的說明，他反而有些糊塗了，看來我的解釋不太清楚。
examples.pinyin: Jīngguò wǒ de shuōmíng, tā fǎn'ér yǒuxiē hútú le, kànlái wǒ de jiěshì bù tài qīngchu.
examples.english: After my explanation, he actually became somewhat confused; it seems my explanation wasn't very clear.

examples.chinese: 有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē guójiā de chuántǒng xìjù cháng lìyòng yǐngzi hé dēngguāng xiàoguǒ lái biǎoyǎn.
examples.english: Traditional theater in some countries often uses shadows and lighting effects to perform.

examples.chinese: 有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shì rěnnài yīxià jiù guòqù le, shénme dōu xiǎng yǐ chǎojià de fāngshì jiějué, chízǎo huì chūshì de.
examples.english: Some things pass after enduring them for a bit; if you want to solve everything by arguing, sooner or later there will be an accident.

examples.chinese: 有些病頭幾個月的症狀不明顯，得做進一步的檢查才能確定。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē bìng tóu jǐ gè yuè de zhèngzhuàng bù míngxiǎn, děi zuò jìnyībù de jiǎnchá cái néng quèdìng.
examples.english: For some diseases, the symptoms in the first few months are not obvious; further examination is needed to confirm.

examples.chinese: 那位教授提供病毒給軍隊使用，有些人認為他應該出來道歉。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu tígōng bìngdú gěi jūnduì shǐyòng, yǒuxiē rén rènwéi tā yīnggāi chūlái dàoqiàn.
examples.english: That professor provided viruses for the military to use; some people think he should come out and apologize.

examples.chinese: 有些女性懷孕時飲食習慣會有極大的改變，醫生說這是正常現象。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē nǚxìng huáiyùn shí yǐnshí xíguàn huì yǒu jídà de gǎibiàn, yīshēng shuō zhè shì zhèngcháng xiànxiàng.
examples.english: Some women experience great changes in their eating habits when they become pregnant; doctors say this is a normal phenomenon.

examples.chinese: 有些學校將教育當成商品來買賣，但也有人不支持。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē xuéxiào jiāng jiàoyù dàngchéng shāngpǐn lái mǎimài, dàn yě yǒu rén bù zhīchí.
examples.english: Some schools treat education as a commodity to buy and sell, but there are also people who do not support this.

examples.chinese: 有些事情光是勤勞沒有用，得用對方法才行。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuxiē shìqíng guāng shì qínláo méiyǒu yòng, děi yòng duì fāngfǎ cái xíng.
examples.english: For some things, just being hardworking is not useful; you have to use the right method.

examples.chinese: 小王剛買了一臺電腦，有些功能還不太會操作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng gāng mǎi le yì tái diànnǎo, yǒuxiē gōngnéng hái bú tài huì cāozuò.
examples.english: Xiao Wang just bought a computer, and there are still some functions he doesn't really know how to operate.

examples.chinese: 這位外科醫師不僅很會開刀，對病人也很有耐心。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi wàikē yīshī bùjǐn hěn huì kāidāo, duì bìngrén yě hěn yǒu nàixīn.
examples.english: This surgeon is not only very skilled at performing operations, but also very patient with patients.

examples.chinese: 老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
examples.pinyin: Lǎo Fāng zhùyuàn kāidāo shí, tóngshìmen dōu lúnliú dào yīyuàn wèiwèn bìng zhàogù tā.
examples.english: When Old Fang was hospitalized for surgery, his colleagues all took turns going to the hospital to comfort and take care of him.

items.wordHook: 大(big) + 聲(sound) → a big sound is loud.
A 石(stone) makes you 疑(doubt), and that 疑(doubt) blocks the path → 礙(block).
a 糹(silk) pulp rests with the 氏(clan) seal → one sheet of 紙(paper).
Combining 自(self) and 動(move): 自動 means automatic.
Using modest words of sincere 言(speech) that 兼(combine) respect for others makes a scholar 謙(humble).
還(still) + 是(be) → 'is it still...?' → in questions 還是 means 'or'.
